```{r load}
cfg <- yaml::read_yaml("config/pipeline.yml")
tb <- function(f) utils::read.csv(file.path("results/tables", f))
ann <- tb("annual_burn_days.csv")
var <- tb("burn_day_variability.csv")
rxt <- tb("rx_target_afn_bfn.csv")
thr <- tb("thresholds_applied.csv")
peak <- tb("state_peak_season_STUB.csv")
sann <- tb("state_annual_need_STUB.csv")
fig <- function(f) knitr::asis_output(sprintf("![](../results/figures/%s)\n\n", f))
```

Years: **`r cfg$years$start`–`r cfg$years$end`**. Units: **`r nrow(rxt)`** Fireshed Registry subfiresheds intersecting `r cfg$aoi$state_abbr`. Thresholds: Swain et al. 2023 ST1, `r cfg$thresholds$plan_set` plans. Project burn day: rx_share ≥ `r cfg$rollup$burn_day_share`.

Generated `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")`.

## Annual Rx target

```{r}
fig("afn.png"); fig("bfn.png")
s <- rxt[rxt$treatable_ac > 0, ]
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  units_with_target_area = nrow(s),
  treatable_ac_total = round(sum(s$treatable_ac)),
  afn_ac_total = round(sum(s$afn_ac, na.rm = TRUE)),
  median_mfri_eff_yr = round(stats::median(s$mfri_eff_yr, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
  median_bfn_typical = round(stats::median(s$bfn_typical, na.rm = TRUE), 1)))
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(flag = rxt$flag)))
```
